title: Authentication Failure Handling
ui_behavior: Show the error inline via errorText on the password AppFormField and keep focus there. Keep the entered email/username; never clear it.
bloc_state_pattern: Follow the Client's Cubit state convention. Add a failure state carrying the server message (DataFailure.error.message); keep the typed credentials in the form controllers, not in state.
anti_patterns: Popping up a full-screen blocking dialog for wrong credentials.
Clearing the email/username input field on authentication error.
Resetting password without notifying the user inline.

title: Network Disconnection & Timeout Handling
ui_behavior: Show the error with a clear retry action: inline error view with an AppButton retry for page loads, or AppDialog.show for a failed submit. Keep all form input in its controllers so no work is lost.
bloc_state_pattern: Follow the Client's Cubit state convention. Map DataFailure to a failure state with the message; the retry calls the same Cubit method again.
anti_patterns: Wiping form controllers or resetting draft state upon network drop.
Crashing or freezing the interface without communicating with the user.
Infinite loading spinner without timeout feedback.

title: Real-time Field Validation
ui_behavior: Validate on blur or while typing. Show inline errorText under invalid AppFormField inputs (pass a validator whenever isRequired is true). Disable the submit AppButton until mandatory fields are valid.
bloc_state_pattern: Follow the Client's Cubit state convention. Keep isValid and per-field errors in state only if the screen needs them beyond the Form's own validation.
anti_patterns: Showing dialogs for field-level validation errors.
Waiting until submit to show all errors in one popup.
Permitting submit when mandatory fields are empty.

title: Empty Data / No Records State
ui_behavior: Show AppNoData with an explanatory text, plus an AppButton when the user can create the first record. With ListViewPaging, pass it as noDataBuilder.
bloc_state_pattern: Follow the Client's Cubit state convention. A success state with an empty list renders the empty view; it is not an error.
anti_patterns: Showing a completely blank screen when the list is empty.
Showing an error when 0 records are returned normally.
